say:4:1010523003:1.text: I knew it... You're the great mage I've been worshipping for all along!
say:4:1010523003:1.source_cn: 果然……您就是我一直追寻的大魔法师！
say:4:1010523003:1.male: I knew it... You're the great mage I've been worshipping for all along!
say:4:1010523003:1.female: I knew it... You're the great mage I've been worshipping for all along!

say:5:1010523006:1.text: But if anyone's a fool... It's me! I should've noticed it sooner! After all, the book always mentions Merlin's unique taste in familiars!
say:5:1010523006:1.source_cn: 对啊……我真傻！我早该发现的！书上不是说过吗？梅林对于...
say:5:1010523006:1.male: But if anyone's a fool... It's me! I should've noticed it sooner! After all, the book always mentions Merlin's unique taste in familiars!
say:5:1010523006:1.female: But if anyone's a fool... It's me! I should've noticed it sooner! After all, the book always mentions Merlin's unique taste in familiars!

say:8:1010523007:1.text: ...Which book? I'll rip it to shreds!
say:8:1010523007:1.source_cn: ……哪本书写了那种东西？我要撕了它！

say:11:1010523008:1.text: Miss Mirael... Did you already know who the magister was, too?
say:11:1010523008:1.source_cn: 米瑞尔小姐……你早就认出主人的身份了？
say:11:1010523008:1.male: Miss Mirael... Did you already know who the magister was, too?
say:11:1010523008:1.female: Miss Mirael... Did you already know who the magister was, too?

say:12:1010523009:1.text: Yes. No matter what magic he used to conceal it, I was never fooled.
say:12:1010523009:1.male: Yes. No matter what magic he used to conceal it, I was never fooled.
say:12:1010523009:1.female: Yes. No matter what magic she used to conceal it, I was never fooled.

say:13:1010523010:1.text: At first, I was only suspicious, but when we fought against that wind elemental, I saw his magical array.
say:13:1010523010:1.source_cn: 虽然一开始，我也只是怀疑，直至与风元素战斗时，我见到了...
say:13:1010523010:1.male: At first, I was only suspicious, but when we fought against that wind elemental, I saw his magical array.
say:13:1010523010:1.female: At first, I was only suspicious, but when we fought against that wind elemental, I saw her magical array.

say:15:1010523011:1.text: Sorry to interrupt, Miss Mirael, but you seem aware of everything. Do you happen to know where that Hypofiend came from?
say:15:1010523011:1.source_cn: 抱歉打断你了，米瑞尔小姐，你好像对这一切都很清楚？请问...

say:16:1010523012:1.text: You've all been lied to this entire time... Lied to by my mentor.
say:16:1010523012:1.source_cn: 一直以来，你们都被假象蒙蔽了——被老师亲手塑造的假象。
say:16:1010523012:1.male: You've all been lied to this entire time... Lied to by my mentor.
say:16:1010523012:1.female: You've all been lied to this entire time... Lied to by my mentor.

say:17:1010523013:1.text: What Merlin placed over Ryeham wasn't a ward.
say:17:1010523013:1.source_cn: 梅林老师在金穗村设下的，根本不是加护。

say:19:1010523015:1.text: As for why this Hypofiend appeared when it did... It was pure coincidence, as far as I can tell.
say:19:1010523015:1.source_cn: 至于为什么魔物会在这个时间点现身……巧合，我只能这样解释了。

say:20:1010523016:1.text: The seal continues to weaken, and the Hypofiend used a brief lapse in the seal's power to escape.
say:20:1010523016:1.source_cn: 封印越来越脆弱，刚好在那一刻产生裂缝，魔物得以逃出封印。

say:21:1010523017:1.text: Somehow, I doubt it was a coincidence. If anything, it was probably part of Dura's plan.
say:21:1010523017:1.source_cn: 我总觉得，世上没那么多巧合，只有必然。也许，这都是艾雅...

say:22:1010523018:1.text: Anyway... You must have forgotten that you placed a seal on this place long ago, right, Merlin?
say:22:1010523018:1.source_cn: 不过话说回来……梅林，你早就忘了曾经在这里设下的封印吧？
say:22:1010523018:1.male: Anyway... You must have forgotten that you placed a seal on this place long ago, right, Merlin?
say:22:1010523018:1.female: Anyway... You must have forgotten that you placed a seal on this place long ago, right, Merlin?

say:23:1010523019:1.text: Otherwise, you would have known someone was trying to break the seal, and we wouldn't have gone through all of that trouble.
say:23:1010523019:1.source_cn: 要不然，你也早该意识到有人想要解开封印，我们不至于兜这...
say:23:1010523019:1.male: Otherwise, you would have known someone was trying to break the seal, and we wouldn't have gone through all of that trouble.
say:23:1010523019:1.female: Otherwise, you would have known someone was trying to break the seal, and we wouldn't have gone through all of that trouble.

say:25:1010523020:1.text: The way you said that, you didn't sound surprised at all. When did you figure out who he was?
say:25:1010523020:1.source_cn: 你这一声“梅林”丝毫听不出惊讶啊，难道你早就猜出了<m...
say:25:1010523020:1.male: The way you said that, you didn't sound surprised at all. When did you figure out who he was?
say:25:1010523020:1.female: The way you said that, you didn't sound surprised at all. When did you figure out who she was?

say:26:1010523021:1.text: Please. General Hogan would have kicked me out of the Heroic Order ages ago if I couldn't even figure out that much.
say:26:1010523021:1.source_cn: 要是连这都看不出，霍根将军早把我踢出骑士团了。

say:28:1010523022:1.text: Anyways, how was Merlin's seal broken in the first place? It couldn't just be those grapes, right?
say:28:1010523022:1.source_cn: 可是，那些人究竟如何撼动了梅林的封印呢？光靠那些葡萄吗？
say:28:1010523022:1.male: Anyways, how was Merlin's seal broken in the first place? It couldn't just be those grapes, right?
say:28:1010523022:1.female: Anyways, how was Merlin's seal broken in the first place? It couldn't just be those grapes, right?

say:29:1010523023:1.text: Don't underestimate those grapes. Even though they're not magical...
say:29:1010523023:1.source_cn: 可不要小瞧那些了葡萄。其实，葡萄本身并没有魔力。

say:30:1010523024:1.text: They're like ticks, sucking the power from the earth, contaminating the leylines and disrupting the magical balance of the land. In doing so...
say:30:1010523024:1.source_cn: 但它们就像一只只蜱虫，匍匐在大地上，吸食着地脉中的力量...

say:32:1010523026:1.text: Ah! Does that mean the strange weather in Ryeham is being caused by a magical imbalance in nature?
say:32:1010523026:1.source_cn: 啊！所以金穗村的气候异变，是因为自然中的魔法失衡？

say:34:1010523028:1.text: As it stands, there is only a small break in the seal. But if you fail to repair it soon, the consequences will be unimaginable.
say:34:1010523028:1.source_cn: 虽然，现在封印上只出现了一道浅浅的裂缝，但是，如果你们...

say:35:1010523029:1.text: The Hypofiend was not the only thing sealed beneath these lands. There's no telling what other sinister things are hidden underneath.
say:35:1010523029:1.source_cn: 这片土地之下，不止封印着那一个魔物。我也不知道这下面究...

say:37:1010523030:1.text: Heh. Mysterious as ever, Magister Merlin.
say:37:1010523030:1.source_cn: 梅林老师，您总是那么神秘，不肯向我透露更多。
say:37:1010523030:1.male: Heh. Mysterious as ever, Magister Merlin.
say:37:1010523030:1.female: Heh. Mysterious as ever, Magister Merlin.

say:38:1010523031:1.text: Even now, you are still unwilling to tell me more than what is necessary. I imagine it's because... I no longer exist in your memories.
say:38:1010523031:1.source_cn: 就连现在，您也不愿同我多说。因为你的记忆里……早已没有...
say:38:1010523031:1.male: Even now, you are still unwilling to tell me more than what is necessary. I imagine it's because... I no longer exist in your memories.
say:38:1010523031:1.female: Even now, you are still unwilling to tell me more than what is necessary. I imagine it's because... I no longer exist in your memories.

say:39:1010523032:1.text: I've been searching for you for the last twenty years.
say:39:1010523032:1.source_cn: 二十年了，我一直在寻找您。
say:39:1010523032:1.male: I've been searching for you for the last twenty years.
say:39:1010523032:1.female: I've been searching for you for the last twenty years.

say:40:1010523033:1.text: But no matter what magic I employed, I found no trace of you. At the time, I feared that something had happened to you.
say:40:1010523033:1.source_cn: 可无论用传讯术，还是预言术，您依然杳无音信。那个时候，...
say:40:1010523033:1.male: But no matter what magic I employed, I found no trace of you. At the time, I feared that something had happened to you.
say:40:1010523033:1.female: But no matter what magic I employed, I found no trace of you. At the time, I feared that something had happened to you.

say:41:1010523034:1.text: I don't blame you for forgetting about me, but...
say:41:1010523034:1.source_cn: 所以，即便您将我遗忘，我也不会责怪您。我只是……
say:41:1010523034:1.male: I don't blame you for forgetting about me, but...
say:41:1010523034:1.female: I don't blame you for forgetting about me, but...

say:44:1010523036:1.text: I never thought you, of all people, would console me someday. You used to be so strict with me, after all.
say:44:1010523036:1.source_cn: 没想到，我还能听到您的安慰。过去，您总严厉地指责我。
say:44:1010523036:1.male: I never thought you, of all people, would console me someday. You used to be so strict with me, after all.
say:44:1010523036:1.female: I never thought you, of all people, would console me someday. You used to be so strict with me, after all.

say:46:1010523040:1.text: You are incredible, Lady Mirael! I have nothing but the utmost respect for you!
say:46:1010523040:1.source_cn: 米瑞尔大人，您真了不起！我太崇拜您了！

say:47:1010523041:1.text: I've never seen or heard of any other mage who could command Merlin's magic! Did Magister Merlin teach you this?
say:47:1010523041:1.source_cn: 我从来没听说过哪个魔法师能使用梅林的术式！是梅林大人亲...
say:47:1010523041:1.male: I've never seen or heard of any other mage who could command Merlin's magic! Did Magister Merlin teach you this?
say:47:1010523041:1.female: I've never seen or heard of any other mage who could command Merlin's magic! Did Magister Merlin teach you this?

say:48:1010523042:1.text: Yes. Magister Merlin once said that I was his greatest student and this was his reward for me.
say:48:1010523042:1.male: Yes. Magister Merlin once said that I was his greatest student and this was his reward for me.
say:48:1010523042:1.female: Yes. Magister Merlin once said that I was her greatest student and this was her reward for me.

say:49:1010523043:1.text: Wow... I'm so jealous of you!

say:50:1010523044:1.text: But in the end, I was forgotten by my dearest teacher. I'd rather that he never truly cared for me.
say:50:1010523044:1.source_cn: 如果，结局是被最喜欢的老师遗忘，我宁可从未被<male...
say:50:1010523044:1.male: But in the end, I was forgotten by my dearest teacher. I'd rather that he never truly cared for me.
say:50:1010523044:1.female: But in the end, I was forgotten by my dearest teacher. I'd rather that she never truly cared for me.

say:52:1010523045:1.text: I'm sure my Magister didn't want to forget you, Miss Mirael.
say:52:1010523045:1.source_cn: 米瑞尔小姐，我相信，主人也不想忘记你。
say:52:1010523045:1.male: I'm sure my Magister didn't want to forget you, Miss Mirael.
say:52:1010523045:1.female: I'm sure my Magister didn't want to forget you, Miss Mirael.

say:53:1010523046:1.text: Magister places a lot of importance on the feelings of others! It's just... A lot of things have happened lately, and you're not the only person who's been forgotten.
say:53:1010523046:1.source_cn: 主人最重视感情了！但是……这些年发生了很多事，主人忘记...
say:53:1010523046:1.male: Magister places a lot of importance on the feelings of others! It's just... A lot of things have happened lately, and you're not the only person who's been forgotten.
say:53:1010523046:1.female: Magister places a lot of importance on the feelings of others! It's just... A lot of things have happened lately, and you're not the only person who's been forgotten.

say:54:1010523047:1.text: I see... Thank you, little one.

say:56:1010523048:1.text: Magister Merlin... To this day, I still haven't mastered the techniques you once taught me. Even after twenty years, I still have yet to catch up to you.
say:56:1010523048:1.source_cn: 梅林老师，事到如今，我还是没法熟练使用您的术式。二十年...
say:56:1010523048:1.male: Magister Merlin... To this day, I still haven't mastered the techniques you once taught me. Even after twenty years, I still have yet to catch up to you.
say:56:1010523048:1.female: Magister Merlin... To this day, I still haven't mastered the techniques you once taught me. Even after twenty years, I still have yet to catch up to you.

say:57:1010523049:1.text: But for many, it is only in the coldness of solitude that a flame is finally sparked. As it stands, it looks like you no longer need me.
say:57:1010523049:1.source_cn: 人们总是在孤寂而寒冷的时候，才会点燃火焰。如今的您，好...
say:57:1010523049:1.male: But for many, it is only in the coldness of solitude that a flame is finally sparked. As it stands, it looks like you no longer need me.
say:57:1010523049:1.female: But for many, it is only in the coldness of solitude that a flame is finally sparked. As it stands, it looks like you no longer need me.

say:58:1010523050:1.text: But even if it's in the smallest of ways... Just this once, could I please help you?
say:58:1010523050:1.source_cn: 不过，哪怕是一点点也好，这一次……我有帮到您吗？
say:58:1010523050:1.male: But even if it's in the smallest of ways... Just this once, could I please help you?
say:58:1010523050:1.female: But even if it's in the smallest of ways... Just this once, could I please help you?

choice_prompt:59:1010523050.text: But even if it's in the smallest of ways... Just this once, could I please help you?
choice_prompt:59:1010523050.source_cn: 不过，哪怕是一点点也好，这一次……我有帮到您吗？
choice_prompt:59:1010523050.male: But even if it's in the smallest of ways... Just this once, could I please help you?
choice_prompt:59:1010523050.female: But even if it's in the smallest of ways... Just this once, could I please help you?

say:61:1010523052:1.text: After all, you are my dearest...
say:61:1010523052:1.male: After all, you are my dearest...
say:61:1010523052:1.female: After all, you are my dearest...

say:71:1010523037:1.text: M-Magister! Chippy thinks it's time to comfort Miss Mirael!
say:71:1010523037:1.source_cn: 主、主人！这时候不应该安慰米瑞尔小姐吗？
say:71:1010523037:1.male: M-Magister! Chippy thinks it's time to comfort Miss Mirael!
say:71:1010523037:1.female: M-Magister! Chippy thinks it's time to comfort Miss Mirael!

say:72:1010523038:1.text: He would never try to console me.
say:72:1010523038:1.male: He would never try to console me.
say:72:1010523038:1.female: She would never try to console me.

say:73:1010523039:1.text: A harsh and unforgiving instructor, that is the Merlin I know.
say:73:1010523039:1.source_cn: 唯有严厉地指责和教导，这才是我认识的梅林老师。
say:73:1010523039:1.male: A harsh and unforgiving instructor, that is the Merlin I know.
say:73:1010523039:1.female: A harsh and unforgiving instructor, that is the Merlin I know.

say:75:1010523004:1.text: Please don't deny it! I'm your most loyal follower!
say:75:1010523004:1.source_cn: 请别否认！我是您最忠诚的粉丝！
say:75:1010523004:1.male: Please don't deny it! I'm your most loyal follower!
say:75:1010523004:1.female: Please don't deny it! I'm your most loyal follower!

say:76:1010523005:1.text: Even your tendency to act foolish is exactly the same as Magister Merlin!
say:76:1010523005:1.source_cn: 就连喜欢装傻这一点也和那位梅林大人一模一样！
say:76:1010523005:1.male: Even your tendency to act foolish is exactly the same as Magister Merlin!
say:76:1010523005:1.female: Even your tendency to act foolish is exactly the same as Magister Merlin!
